description: A warm, contemporary living room with a two-tone painted wall — saturated terracotta-rust on the left portion and soft cream on the right — meeting at an off-center vertical seam behind a white-painted fireplace with an ornate molded mantel surround and an active flame visible through the opening. On the mantel, a large framed abstract print in terracotta, cream, and dark maroon leans against the wall, flanked by a slender wooden ribbed decorative object. To the right of the fireplace, a tall white ceramic vase holds dried brown floral stems. The floor is light oak herringbone parquet. A large graphic area rug in off-white with abstract black line work and a pink circle motif anchors the seating area. A plush cream long-fur armchair with a generously oversized form sits centered on the rug. To the left of the chair, a slender black upright post on a round disc base stands on the herringbone floor, emitting a warm amber-gold glow from a cylindrical cream shade at standing height that warms the terracotta wall section behind it. Camera is at standing eye-level using a normal to wide lens, centered-symmetrical wide establishing view. Camera pitch is level.
